title: A9 output files: ncert/change_log.csv and ncert/deleted_topics.csv
description: A9 is pure SCRIPT (write_change_log.py), no agent. It writes TWO csv files in one pass (Section 9/A9 Writes; Section 6.4 column lists). Since this project's schemas/<STEP>.json convention is one JSON Schema file per step, this schema models A9's combined output as one JSON object with two arrays — change_log_rows (one per non-identical A7/A8 pair, per Section 6.4's change_log.csv columns) and deleted_topics_rows (one per A6 'removed' passage, per Section 6.4's deleted_topics.csv columns). A build turning this into the actual two CSV files just emits one array per file; this is a design choice of this build, not a literal quote from the spec (which gives column lists, not a JSON shape, for these two csv files).

subtopic_id.description: The subtopic the changed passage(s) link to, or 'none'.

change_type.description: A8's resolved change_type (Section 17.1); 'unsure' from a raw A8 run must not reach this log unresolved.

old_text.description: The older passage's full text (or the relevant span).

new_text.description: The latest passage's full text (or the relevant span).

affected_questions.description: Empty at A9 write time; filled after Stage D from every question whose D4/D5 evidence cites either passage (Section 9/A9 procedure).

approval.description: 'pending' when A9 first writes the row (Section 9/A9 Writes line); changed only through a Stage F decision. No fixed enum is given in the spec beyond this, so this build does not invent one.

old_pages.description: Page range in the older edition, e.g. '160-161'.

heading.description: The older edition's own heading text for this passage.

subtopic_hint.description: Best-guess subtopic name for a removed topic with no latest-edition subtopic id (it was never linked to one, by definition of 'removed').
